plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix audio codec auto-detection on piCorePlayer and systems where ffmpeg lacks MP3 support. Codec detection now runs after ffmpeg path is resolved. Fix persistent YoutubeDL failing to find yt_dlp module on some systems. Thanks to CJS.
